use_cases: Triggering primary actions in forms and interfaces
Navigation controls with multiple visual variants
Toolbar and action bar controls in applications
Icon-only buttons for compact UI spaces
ai_summary: A reusable button component with multiple variants (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link) and sizes built using class-variance-authority for type-safe variant management. Features Radix UI Slot for composition, disabled states, focus ring accessibility, and subtle shadow styling. Supports asChild prop for rendering as other elements.
